controls.label: Layer start
controls.meaning: Adjusts layer start of an image/video overlay; timing remains linked to its owned occurrence.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Layer duration
controls.meaning: Adjusts layer duration of an image/video overlay; timing remains linked to its owned occurrence.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Layer width

controls.label: Layer height
controls.meaning: Adjusts layer height of an image/video overlay; timing remains linked to its owned occurrence.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Keyframe time
controls.meaning: Places a property key on the programme clock; timeline nudges use the output frame grid.
limitations: The current programme/layer range supplies the upper bound; no universal fixed duration is claimed.

controls.label: Keyframe easing
controls.meaning: Selects the interpolation between property poses. Hold retains the prior value until the next key.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Cubic curve handles
controls.meaning: Sets the bounded cubic interpolation curve; X handles stay 0–1 and Y handles may overshoot -2–2 in the shared contract.
limitations: Array contains exactly four handles. Shared contract permits Y overshoot; some inspector widgets show narrower Y bounds.

controls.label: Layer blend mode
controls.meaning: Chooses how an ordinary overlay blends with the underlying image.
limitations: Main programme video currently supports normal only; unsupported main-video modes are rejected at export.

controls.label: Layer blur
controls.meaning: Adjusts the supported ordinary-layer layer blur. These controls are distinct from mask-scene glow.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Glow radius
controls.meaning: Adjusts the supported ordinary-layer glow radius. These controls are distinct from mask-scene glow.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Glow intensity
controls.meaning: Adjusts the supported ordinary-layer glow intensity. These controls are distinct from mask-scene glow.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Shadow blur
controls.meaning: Adjusts the supported ordinary-layer shadow blur. These controls are distinct from mask-scene glow.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Shadow opacity
controls.meaning: Adjusts the supported ordinary-layer shadow opacity. These controls are distinct from mask-scene glow.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Motion blur samples
controls.meaning: Adjusts the supported ordinary-layer motion blur samples. These controls are distinct from mask-scene glow.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Motion blur shutter
controls.meaning: Adjusts the supported ordinary-layer motion blur shutter. These controls are distinct from mask-scene glow.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Subject text X
controls.meaning: Places or styles editable text inside the reviewed mask-backed scene.
limitations: Scene parameter; arbitrary native per-property keyframe support is not implemented.

controls.label: Subject text Y
controls.meaning: Places or styles editable text inside the reviewed mask-backed scene.
limitations: Scene parameter; arbitrary native per-property keyframe support is not implemented.

controls.label: Subject text size
controls.meaning: Places or styles editable text inside the reviewed mask-backed scene.
limitations: Scene parameter; arbitrary native per-property keyframe support is not implemented.

controls.label: Subject letter spacing
controls.meaning: Places or styles editable text inside the reviewed mask-backed scene.
limitations: Scene parameter; arbitrary native per-property keyframe support is not implemented.

controls.label: Tracked callout X offset
controls.meaning: Offsets the supported callout relative to its real tracked subject.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Tracked callout Y offset
controls.meaning: Offsets the supported callout relative to its real tracked subject.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Subject source range
controls.meaning: Selects one owned source-bound span to segment and composite.
limitations: Two source times; duration must be 0.25–10 seconds. Source bounds and frame count are validated.

controls.label: Subject seed points
controls.meaning: Selects the visible subject with positive and optional negative points.
limitations: 1–16 coordinate pairs; normalized coordinates 0–0.999999. At least one positive label is required.

controls.label: Subject point labels
controls.meaning: Labels each seed as positive foreground or negative background.
limitations: One 0 or 1 label per seed point; at least one 1.

controls.label: Mask parallax amount
controls.meaning: Changes the restrained 2.5D subject/background parallax amount.
limitations: Mask-based effect; does not estimate metric depth.

controls.label: Mask feather
controls.meaning: No exposed supported subject-scene mask feather field is established in the current scene contract.
limitations: No valid range or default is documented because this field is not implemented.

controls.label: Mask expansion
controls.meaning: No exposed supported subject-scene mask expansion field is established in the current scene contract.
limitations: No valid range or default is documented because this field is not implemented.

controls.label: Camera count
controls.meaning: Two or three source cameras are accepted by the combiner.
limitations: Applies only to the camera session. Speaker mapping must be reviewed before relying on suggested cuts.

controls.label: Camera sync offset
controls.meaning: Maps programme time to the selected source using the reviewed offset.
limitations: Applies only to the camera session. Speaker mapping must be reviewed before relying on suggested cuts.

controls.label: Camera clock rate
controls.meaning: Multiplies mapped source time to compensate for drift. Normal automatic estimation is narrower than the mapping clamp.
limitations: Automatic drift estimation is normally clamped to 0.99–1.01; source time mapping clamps to 0.95–1.05.

controls.label: Switch interval
controls.meaning: Sets the baseline hold interval used by the heuristic planner.
limitations: Applies only to the camera session. Speaker mapping must be reviewed before relying on suggested cuts.

controls.label: Camera framing zoom
controls.meaning: Crops the selected source within the normalized segment framing.
limitations: Applies only to the camera session. Speaker mapping must be reviewed before relying on suggested cuts.

controls.label: Swap left/right clean-audio channels
controls.meaning: Reverses speaker/camera channel association; listen to the master and verify the intended camera.
limitations: Applies only to the camera session. Speaker mapping must be reviewed before relying on suggested cuts.

controls.label: I verified which speaker belongs to each channel
controls.meaning: Confirms the current mapping after listening. Changing mapping requires confirming it again.
limitations: Applies only to the camera session. Speaker mapping must be reviewed before relying on suggested cuts.

controls.label: Clean audio mode
controls.meaning: Selects external-only, low-camera-bed or muted-camera mix policy.
limitations: Applies only to the camera session. Speaker mapping must be reviewed before relying on suggested cuts.

controls.label: Denoise
controls.meaning: Adjusts deterministic denoise in the voice-repair bus. The documented default is the natural repair preset.
limitations: Preset default; the selected project may retain different values. Preview and final repaired-bus agreement is qualified only for retained subsets.

controls.label: De-esser
controls.meaning: Adjusts deterministic de-esser in the voice-repair bus. The documented default is the natural repair preset.
limitations: Preset default; the selected project may retain different values. Preview and final repaired-bus agreement is qualified only for retained subsets.

controls.label: Compressor
controls.meaning: Adjusts deterministic compressor in the voice-repair bus. The documented default is the natural repair preset.
limitations: Preset default; the selected project may retain different values. Preview and final repaired-bus agreement is qualified only for retained subsets.

controls.label: Limiter ceiling
controls.meaning: Adjusts deterministic limiter ceiling in the voice-repair bus. The documented default is the natural repair preset.
limitations: Preset default; the selected project may retain different values. Preview and final repaired-bus agreement is qualified only for retained subsets.

controls.label: Loudness target
controls.meaning: Adjusts deterministic loudness target in the voice-repair bus. The documented default is the natural repair preset.
limitations: Preset default; the selected project may retain different values. Preview and final repaired-bus agreement is qualified only for retained subsets.

controls.label: EQ low
controls.meaning: Adjusts the low band of the deterministic voice repair EQ.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: EQ mid

controls.label: EQ high

controls.label: Hum removal

limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Bus volume key
controls.meaning: Changes the selected audio bus gain over programme time; 100% means unity.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Automation source
controls.meaning: Selects which programme audio bus the volume keys affect.
limitations: Scope is the listed feature; do not transfer this range or support claim to another inspector.

controls.label: Speech-aware ducking
controls.meaning: Use the existing music automation/ducking workflow and review its audible result; no universal ducking threshold range is asserted here.
limitations: Music also exposes strength and mode. This is not neural speech separation.

controls.label: Exposure stops

controls.label: Music volume
controls.meaning: Sets the music base gain independently of bus automation.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Music fadeIn
controls.meaning: Fades the music cue at its boundaries.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Music fadeOut
controls.meaning: Fades the music cue at its boundaries.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Duck strength
controls.meaning: Sets how strongly music is reduced in the selected ducking mode.
limitations: UI slider is 10–90%; other internal prepared-mix paths use their own bounded contract.
Default shown in this music inspector is 0.4, not a universal render/provider default.

controls.label: Ducking mode
controls.meaning: Chooses speech-aware music reduction or a constant reduction.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Effect volume
controls.meaning: Sets the individual sound cue gain before the SFX bus envelope.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Sound cue duration
controls.meaning: Sets the duration of the selected cue.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Sound source trim start
controls.meaning: Moves the starting sample of an owned external sound cue.
limitations: Disabled for built-in synthesized cues; external sources remain bounded by their actual duration.

controls.label: Voice take volume
controls.meaning: Sets an owned voice take gain; unity is 1.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Voice take duration
controls.meaning: Bounds the placed voice take and decoded source checks.
limitations: Import also enforces a 128 MB size limit. Supported PCM preview uses a narrower short-take subset; longer/retimed speech uses the media path.

controls.label: Clip/programme speed
controls.meaning: Sets the native speed rate; keys and linked content use the shared time map.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Join transition duration
controls.meaning: Sets a supported join duration after a removed source range.
limitations: Clean cut uses 0.02 seconds; the 0.04–2 range describes non-clean joins in this operation.
Other occurrence transitions retain their own contract.

controls.label: Title text
controls.meaning: Edits the ordinary title copy.
limitations: Current title editor maxLength is 180 characters. Long copy still needs layout review.

controls.label: Title size
controls.meaning: Sets title size in the title typography inspector.
limitations: Title size widget is 0.5–2; ordinary motion inspector scale is a different 0.1–5 range.

controls.label: Title text color
controls.meaning: Sets a supported title color.
limitations: Use a valid color from the existing picker; contrast must be reviewed over the actual footage.

controls.label: Background exposure
controls.meaning: Grades the original background around the mask.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Background saturation
controls.meaning: Grades the original background around the mask.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Background contrast
controls.meaning: Grades the original background around the mask.
limitations: This is the exposed control range; other inspector or worker bounds may be narrower for a specific operation.

controls.label: Maximum generated cutaways
controls.meaning: Bounds the requested B-roll planning batch.
limitations: UI batch choice; server allowance and provider availability remain authoritative.

controls.label: Queue period
controls.meaning: Shows schedules in the next seven days or the full stored queue.
limitations: Loading account-owned schedules does not confirm external delivery.
Queue navigation does not control movie rendering.

controls.label: Load more schedules
controls.meaning: Loads another owned queue page when more entries are available.
limitations: Results remain limited to the selected period.
Queue navigation does not control movie rendering.
